memory_caps.docker_socket_note: The bind container mounts the host /var/run/docker.sock and /usr/bin/docker so bind_elab can start its yosys container. A container with the host docker socket can start ANY sibling container, including uncapped ones; the only caps on those siblings are the ones the caller passes. Here the only sibling started is bind_elab's yosys run, which always passes --memory=32g --memory-swap=32g (tools/die_plan/bind_elab.py run_yosys). Do not reuse this launcher pattern with code that starts other containers without checking each docker run carries a memory cap.
